note: Design v1.1 §14.1 / §14.5 as data. channel: news (摆渡新闻), tieba (贴吧帖), yy (YY 群), taobao (淘货上新), tray (托盘气泡). Push channels (yy, tray) arrive when the calendar reaches the date; the others are lists the apps read (only dated on or before today). brief = one-line headline only (politics, deaths). until + repeatMinutes = a tray bubble that comes back until that date.
